description: This file is a seed script for initializing demo data for a habits and tasks tracking application. It defines functions to create habits and tasks with randomized IDs, and assembles initial sample data including habits with completed days, and tasks with various statuses. The buildSeedState function returns the initial application state object including habits, tasks, filters, and UI settings.

methods.name: makeHabit({ name, description, color, completedDaysAgo = [] })
methods.description: Creates a habit object with a unique ID, calculated streaks, and completion dates based on provided parameters.

methods.name: makeTask({ title, description, status, priority, dueDate, tags, completedAt })
methods.description: Creates a task object with a unique ID and provided task details.

ctags.name: makeTask
ctags.pattern: /^function makeTask({ title, description, status, priority, dueDate, tags, completedAt }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ title, description, status, priority, dueDate, tags, completedAt })
